views.name: hull_rig
findings: The full model retains three separate lateen masts with tall triangular canvas, angled yards, stays and ratlines; the small aftermast remains distinct behind the two larger rigs.

The deep ochre hull shows two working gun levels, a broad pale working deck and raised ends. Small glazed lights flank the external rudder on the green transom, while the deck openings and carried boat remain visible below the rig.
views.scope: Whole actual GLB with all visible hull, rig and sails.

views.name: deck_closeup
findings: The large coamed hatch is a real opening exposing the complete sloping timber stair, separate treads and strings, upright posts and rope handrails, with a continuous lower planked working floor visible beside the descent.

Longitudinal grain and staggered plank seams remain visible across the pale weather deck and lower sole. The separate coaming timbers and under-edge support pieces read clearly at the matched 4.5 metre field, with the gun carriage and carried-boat corner appearing at the edges.
views.scope: Actual deck and fitting close-up at a fixed 4.5 metre physical field; rig hidden for visibility.

views.name: gun_deck_0_interior
findings: The intact lower battery shows real guns on wheeled wooden carriages on both sides, open port apertures, curved side frames and a continuous planked sole beneath a separate beamed ceiling.

The foreground access stair reaches the open weather-deck hatch, with separate treads, stringers, upright posts and rope rails. Clear floor remains visible beside the stair and between the two battery lines.

The near stair and timber grain are bright and legible under the matched review fill; the more distant gun bays remain darker. The separate cutaway supplements this intact enclosed-room view rather than replacing it.
views.label: Belowdeck battery: gun_deck_0
views.scope: Intact eye-height view along the actual belowdeck battery aisle; gun carriages, ports, hull and overhead timbers retained. Auxiliary camera fill only.

views.name: gun_deck_0_cutaway
findings: The cutaway exposes the repeated curved frame sequence, the long planked working layer and several complete stair flights, making the ship's separate levels and access locations readable.

Upper fittings, guns and the carried boat remain visible above the opened structure while enclosing hull/deck layers are hidden only for this inspection. This is supplementary to the separate intact battery image; retained upper objects should not be read as equipment on the lower floor.
views.label: Belowdeck battery cutaway: gun_deck_0
views.scope: Read-only cutaway: named outer hull, upper deck timbers and bulkheads temporarily hidden; delivered GLB unchanged.

views.name: hold_interior
findings: The intact hold shows a long curved frame sequence, overhead deck beams and knees, inner strakes and a planked sole with visible longitudinal grain and staggered board joints.
A strapped planked crate supports a ring-handled lantern and a cask stands in a farther bay. The large mast and its wooden floor partner remain separate from the broad clear central floor route.

Compared with the matched old Brig hold, the exposed ribs, beam/knee construction and timber texture provide much more explicit structural detail. The near framing and floor are readable under review fill; the far end remains darker.
views.scope: Camera inside the actual enclosed GLB room; auxiliary camera fill reveals timber and furniture.

views.name: hold_cutaway
findings: The hold cutaway reveals the lower planked sole, curved ribs, provision casks and planked crates, with the long access flights continuing between the separate deck levels.

The carried boat, upper guns, rig fittings and some upper stores remain visible over the exposed frame structure while named enclosing layers are temporarily hidden. The wide, brightly lit cutaway explains the arrangement; the intact hold image supplies the closer texture and enclosure evidence.
views.scope: Read-only cutaway: named outer hull, upper deck timbers and bulkheads temporarily hidden; delivered GLB unchanged.

views.name: cabin_interior
findings: The intact cabin has a broad planked sole, curved side frames, hanging knees and a separately beamed ceiling, with longitudinal grain and board seams readable at the matched adult eye height.
A chart desk, strapped planked chest and the close-stool with raised hinged lid and genuinely open seat are clearly visible. Clear floor extends alongside them toward the actual framed doorway.

The preserved aftermast and its partner partly occlude the doorway, and the berth lies outside this intact framing. The far wall is darker; the separately labelled cutaway supplements furniture-placement evidence without replacing this enclosed-room view.
views.scope: Camera inside the actual enclosed GLB room; auxiliary camera fill reveals timber and furniture.

views.name: cabin_cutaway
findings: The structural cutaway exposes the white-topped berth at upper right, curved after framing and small framed stern lights, with the access stair and rope rail visible between the opened deck layers.

This broad multi-level view retains upper guns, helm and rig fittings above the room while named enclosing layers are temporarily hidden. It supplements the intact cabin and reveals the berth that lies outside that camera framing; it is not a close furniture panorama.
views.scope: Read-only cutaway: named outer hull, upper deck timbers and bulkheads temporarily hidden; delivered GLB unchanged.
